description: CBLAS numerical validation. Produce /app/blas_eval.c implementing these test chains using CBLAS routines. Must compile with: gcc -o /app/blas_eval /app/blas_eval.c -lopenblas -lm

matrix_init_rules.symmetric: S[i*n+j] = 1.0 / (1.0 + abs(i-j))  [full matrix stored, upper triangle used by dsymm]

test_chains.name: blas_basic
test_chains.description: General matrix chain using cblas_dgemm only

test_chains.name: blas_tri
test_chains.description: Lower-triangular + symmetric chain using cblas_dsymm + cblas_dtrmm

output_format: Print one line per chain: chain_name=frobenius_norm (%.10f precision). End with BLAS_EVAL_COMPLETE.
